entities.summary: The Pungcheon Im clan is a Korean clan based in Kwail County, South Hwanghae Province. According to the research held in 2015, the number of Pungcheon Im clan’s member was 143881. Their founder was Im On who was from Shaoxing, China and came to Goryeo. Im On worked as Chao Feng Dai Fu and General-in-Chief during Chungnyeol of Goryeo’s reign. Im Ju, 6 th descendant of Im On, was settled in Hwanghae Province and founded Pungcheon Im clan. Pungcheon Im clan is a bon-gwan.
